Yesterday, Senate Republicans gave our Democratic colleagues the chance to stand with us, and over 80% of Americans who support voter ID, by passing a clean, straightforward amendment. Democrats blocked it.

Every single Democrat should have to explain to the American people why they don’t support this commonsense measure to ensure the integrity and security of our elections.


CBS News (@CBSNews)

An amendment that would require voters to show photo identification to cast a ballot failed to adv

Incredible.

Whether in our airports or in our communities, ICE officers remain dedicated in their mission to protect Americans and safeguard our nation.


Bill Melugin (@BillMelugin_)

WATCH; DHS tells @FoxNews that an ICE agent saved the life of a 1-year-old boy who had gone unresponsive & wasn’t breathing while waiting in a TSA line at JFK airport yesterday. Video shows the boy’s father panicking as the boy goes limp in his arms, before the ICE agent runs over to help. DHS says the ICE agent

TSA officers should not be going without their paychecks while Congress is getting theirs. 

In fact, due to Democrats’ two recent shutdowns, TSA officers have missed paychecks for almost 50% of the fiscal year—that’s unacceptable. We need to pass @SenJohnKennedy’s No Shutdown Paychecks to Politicians Act.

Video

Heading to the floor to vote for @SenJonHusted’s commonsense, clean voter ID measure. 

Given several of my Democratic colleagues have claimed support for voter ID in the past—and an overwhelming majority of their voters support requiring voter ID—I hope they will choose to vote with the American people and protect the security of our elections.


Senate Republican Communications Center (@SRCC)

It's the moment of truth for @SenateDems. Do they support voter ID or not?

Today every senator will

This is a huge victory for women and girls across the world.

Female athletes should be able to compete fairly and safely in every level of sports, including on the Olympic stage. Proud to be a tireless advocate for protecting women and girls in sports.


The Associated Press (@AP)

BREAKING: Trans women athletes are banned from the Olympics by a new IOC policy on female eligibility. apnews.com/article/ioc-olymp…

The Senate should absolutely not leave Washington while our TSA workers miss yet another paycheck, our airports are in chaos, and DHS remains unfunded.

Failing to end this Democrat-led shutdown and protect the American people is not an option.

Video

We have long known that the rise in social media has directly correlated with our youth mental health crisis. Accountability begins now. 

Congress also has a role to play in reining in Big Tech, which has consistently put profits over the American people and, most dangerously, the next generation. I’m working to pass several pieces of legislation in Congress to put parents back in the driver’s seat and protect our children and teens online. I won’t stop fighting until we have addressed this gen

Today, we honor the heroes who have earned our nation’s highest military honor through acts of incredible courage and sacrifice.

We are forever grateful for their service and their legacy. 🇺🇸

Great to join HBCU and HBCC presidents and leaders alongside @ReverendWarnock for a productive roundtable conversation. I’m grateful for their insight and leadership as we continue to work in Congress to ensure these institutions have the funding, tools, and support to advance their research capabilities, including through our bipartisan HBCU Research Capacity Act.

Years ago, parents used to lock the doors at night and know their children were safe but today, the danger is inside our homes on our kids’ phones.

I’m proud to join my colleagues in introducing Sammy’s Law to give parents tools to protect their children online and keep them safe. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

On National Agriculture Day, I’m proud to celebrate the hardworking farmers, cattlemen, and families who keep Alabama and America running.

The Working Families Tax Cuts Act delivered real results for Alabama agriculture—strengthening our farm safety net, investing in research, expanding market access, and protecting family farms for generations to come.

Our nation will be forever grateful to these six American heroes who paid the ultimate sacrifice. I led a resolution in their honor, which passed the Senate unanimously this week.

While their lives were tragically cut short, we will never forget their valor as they selflessly served and defended our country. Please join me in continuing to pray for their loved ones. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

Congratulations to my dear friend @SenMullin on his confirmation as our next Secretary of Homeland Security.

We’re sad to lose him in the Senate, but I’m thrilled that he is taking up the mantle at DHS. There is no one better equipped to meet this moment than Markwayne.

He is committed to securing our interior, standing by our law enforcement, and executing President Trump’s agenda. 

I can’t wait to see everything he’s going to accomplish.
